posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: YRF drops the Alpha teaser on June 10 — Alia leads the first female-fronted entry in the Spy Universe alongside Sharvari, with Bobby Deol and Anil Kapoor. Release locked for July 3.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit paid tribute to Chamkila, Gurdas Maan, and other Punjabi legends before his sold-out Madison Square Garden show. His Imtiaz Ali film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' hits theaters June 12.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi crosses ₹150 crore net in India in just 4 days and storms past $3M in North America, entering the Top 5 all-time first weekend openers on BookMyShow.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: At the center of the Peddi controversy — leaked chats reveal Janhvi objected to certain camera angles during filming. Director Buchi Babu Sana has apologized and announced scene edits for re-release.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon tops IMDb's most anticipated Indian movies list. Rashmika is also reportedly set to star in the MS Subbulakshmi biopic after a look test.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer sues FWICE over a non-cooperation directive amid the Don 3 exit controversy. Meanwhile, his post-apocalyptic thriller 'Pralay' with a ₹300 crore budget begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King confirmed for Christmas 2026 with a ₹350 crore budget — SRK plays an assassin alongside daughter Suhana, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, and an all-star ensemble directed by Siddharth Anand.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Officially joins Allu Arjun in director Atlee's ₹600 crore mega film 'AA22xA6.' She'll use a body double for action scenes while juggling King and Spirit in a packed lineup.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Her action comedy 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' releases June 19. Samantha revealed Sai Pallavi was the original choice and won hearts with her witty viral response: 'Haters? Do I have haters?'

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Weighed in on the Peddi controversy, saying sensuality on screen 'has nothing to do with wearing revealing clothes,' citing iconic scenes from Sridevi and Sharmila Tagore. Also in talks for Salman Khan's superhero film with Raj & DK.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Confirms six months of shooting remain for SS Rajamouli's ₹1,300 crore epic 'Varanasi' with Mahesh Babu. An Antarctica filming schedule has been hinted — a historic first for Indian cinema.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Shooting has begun on his mega-budget ₹600 crore film with director Atlee. The Pushpa star plays twin brothers in a parallel universe setting, with Deepika Padukone and Mrunal Thakur co-starring.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Her biographical drama 'Eetha' — based on legendary Tamasha artist Vithabai Narayangaonkar — locks August 28 release. Also in talks for Vicky Kaushal's mythological drama 'Mahavatar.'

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Named JW Marriott's Global Brand Ambassador and turned heads at Cannes by recreating her iconic 2002 saree look with a bold sindoor statement. Fans dubbed it 'Operation Sindoor.'

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Father Rakesh Roshan shuts down reports of a ₹500 crore budget clash with YRF over Krrish 4, calling it 'nonsense.' Pre-production is ongoing for Hrithik's directorial debut.

posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Celebrated Vicky Kaushal's 38th birthday with rare family photos, giving fans a first glimpse of baby Vihaan. Katrina called it 'truly very special' in an emotional post.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: His rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' — David Dhawan's final directorial — opened to a decent weekend with Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde, battling Peddi's box office dominance.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: His period actioner 'Dragon' with Prashanth Neel eyes a June 2027 release. Ram Charan compared working with his Peddi co-stars to the iconic Naatu Naatu experience with NTR.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Wished 'Toxic' director Geetu Mohandas a heartfelt birthday, calling her 'a genius mind powered by infectious passion.' The Yash-starrer's release has been pushed for a global rollout strategy.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Spotted shooting a mysterious project with Sushmita Sen and Radhika Apte, directed by Shoojit Sircar. No one's talking — 'everybody involved is maintaining absolute silence.'

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: His farewell film 'Jananayagan' eyes a July release window after Toxic took the June 4 slot. Both films are produced by KVN Productions with budgets exceeding ₹500 crore each.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: His score and soundtrack for Ram Charan's Peddi is dominating theaters as the film crosses ₹230 crore worldwide in its opening weekend. The Oscar winner reunited with director Buchi Babu Sana for the sports drama.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: The playback queen continues her record-breaking concert tour across India and the US, with multiple sold-out shows. Her Diljit Dosanjh collaboration track remains a streaming favorite.
